subject: Garuda-7B variant consolidation + temporary pin override request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Eva Park <eva@hera.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Garuda-7B variant consolidation + temporary pin override request

Hi team,

Quick context: Hera Labs is ready to move from their current Garuda-7B (v1.3) variant to our new garuda-7b-compact (v2.0) for cost/latency savings. During the integration run yesterday we observed subtle regression signals in their top-5 generation metrics (precision@k and some hallucination indicators) vs v1.3.

As product, I want to request a short-term operational pin on Hera's account to keep serving v1.3 while we finish a targeted rollback for the compact build and run extended evals. Specifically:

- Ask: apply a 72-hour pin for Hera Labs to v1.3 (account-scoped), effective as soon as infra/ops confirm the change.
- Reason: small but consistent regression on domain prompts tied to their docs ingestion; blocking their onboarding cadence.
- Conditions we want: a canary of 5% traffic to v2.0 with telemetry hooks, and a post-pin review at 48h with product+eng+ops.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and a short canary runbook to guide the rollout steps.

Please reply with: (a) compatibility check summary from runtime (kernel/quantization diffs), (b) infra schedule / availability for the pin change, (c) any legal/billing considerations.

Eva — sorry for the churn; we want to avoid a full rollback but also not hold up your launch. We'll coordinate timing.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Product Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eva Park <eva@hera.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Garuda-7B variant consolidation + temporary pin override request

Thanks Soojin — did a quick compatibility sweep this morning. High level results:

- Kernel/quant: v2.0 compact uses a different int8 kernel path and a slightly modified KV cache layout. That combination can change beam scoring at long contexts; explains the precision drop on a small subset of Hera prompts.
- Deterministic failures: none. No crashes, no OOM, inference latency profile is as-expected (~12% lower median).
- Telemetry: attached CSV has the diff breakdown by prompt bucket (short/medium/long). The most affected items are long-context Q&A (3%–6% drop in precision@5).

Recommendation: we can implement a scoped account pinning option (account -> model_version) that routes all Hera requests to v1.3 and keeps v2.0 available for other customers. Ops impact is small but requires a rolling config push to the routing layer and a canary gate. I can prepare the config and compat report; attaching the CSV export.

Open questions for legal/billing: will Hera expect credits/refund for the delay? Not sure — flagging to Sales.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Software Engineering, Inference Runtime
[attachment: compat-report-20250610.csv (text/csv)]

Subject: Re: Garuda-7B variant consolidation + temporary pin override request

Soojin / Kim — thanks for the context and the quick compat sweep. I approve a temporary account-scoped pin to v1.3 under these constraints:

- Scope: Hera Labs account only (no org/global lock).
- Duration: 72 hours from the time Ops applies the pin. We will re-evaluate at 48 hours with the metrics in Kim's report and Hera's integration QA feedback.
- Canary: Ops to enable a 5% traffic canary to v2.0 with the telemetry hooks Kim outlined; product will watch the three signal buckets (precision@5, hallucination rate, end-to-end latency).
- Remediation: if we see regressions persist at 48h, engineering to prioritize a small-parameter patch for v2.0; otherwise plan to re-enable full cutover after 72h.

Eva — we will not change billing for this 72h pin. Sales can discuss longer compensation if the rollout is delayed beyond the window.

David — can you schedule the routing config push and a brief maintenance note to Hera for tomorrow morning? Ops should also capture the pin action in the incident/changes log.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
